'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

FS = 2

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = ["Segment", "Cluster", "ShiftLabel", "ShiftDate", "ShiftType", "Hours"]
df["Hours"] = df["Hours"].fillna(0.0)
df = df[df["Hours"] > 0]

SEG_COLORS = {"hydration": "#e76f51", "foil": "#e9c46a", "schubert": "#2a9d8f",
              "manual": "#636e72", "unattributed": "#b2bec3",
              "web": "#3B82F6", "sealing": "#F59E0B", "handling": "#8B5CF6",
              "pneumatic": "#10B981"}
SEG_ORDER = {"hydration": 0, "foil": 1, "schubert": 2, "web": 0, "sealing": 1,
             "handling": 2, "pneumatic": 3, "manual": 10, "unattributed": 11}

def hex_blend(hexcolor, ratio):
    r = int(hexcolor[1:3], 16); g = int(hexcolor[3:5], 16); b = int(hexcolor[5:7], 16)
    if ratio >= 0:
        r = int(r + (255 - r) * ratio); g = int(g + (255 - g) * ratio); b = int(b + (255 - b) * ratio)
    else:
        f = 1 + ratio; r = int(r * f); g = int(g * f); b = int(b * f)
    return "#%02x%02x%02x" % (max(0, min(255, r)), max(0, min(255, g)), max(0, min(255, b)))

shifts = df[["ShiftLabel", "ShiftDate", "ShiftType"]].drop_duplicates()
shifts["_sort"] = shifts["ShiftType"].map(lambda t: 0 if str(t).lower() == "day" else 1)
shifts = shifts.sort_values(["ShiftDate", "_sort"])
shift_labels = list(shifts["ShiftLabel"])
n = len(shift_labels)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15.6 * FS, 4.6 * FS), dpi=150)

if n == 0:
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No shifts in this selection", ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=13 * FS, color="#636e72")
else:
    totals = df.groupby(["Segment", "Cluster"])["Hours"].sum().reset_index()
    shade_map = {}
    legend_entries = []
    for seg, seg_df in totals.groupby("Segment"):
        seg_df = seg_df.sort_values("Hours", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
        base_color = SEG_COLORS.get(seg, "#b2bec3")
        m = len(seg_df)
        for i, r in seg_df.iterrows():
            shade = hex_blend(base_color, (i * 0.5 / max(m - 1, 1)) if m > 1 else 0.0)
            shade_map[(seg, r["Cluster"])] = shade
            legend_entries.append((seg, r["Cluster"], shade, r["Hours"]))
    legend_entries.sort(key=lambda t: (SEG_ORDER.get(t[0], 5), -t[3]))

    x = list(range(n))
    ymax = df.groupby("ShiftLabel")["Hours"].sum().max() * 1.18

    pending_texts = []
    for xi, lbl in zip(x, shift_labels):
        sdf = df[df["ShiftLabel"] == lbl]
        bottom = 0.0
        segs_here = sorted(sdf["Segment"].unique(), key=lambda s: SEG_ORDER.get(s, 5))
        for seg in segs_here:
            seg_rows = sdf[sdf["Segment"] == seg].sort_values("Hours", ascending=False)
            for _, r in seg_rows.iterrows():
                h = r["Hours"]
                if h <= 0:
                    continue
                shade = shade_map.get((seg, r["Cluster"]), "#b2bec3")
                ax.bar(xi, h, bottom=bottom, width=0.7, color=shade, zorder=2,
                       edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.2)
                full_label = "%s %.1fh" % (r["Cluster"], h)
                t = ax.text(xi, bottom + h / 2.0, full_label, ha="center", va="center",
                            fontsize=8.5 * FS, color="white", fontweight="600", zorder=3, clip_on=True)
                pending_texts.append((t, xi, h, full_label, r["Cluster"]))
                bottom += h

    ax.set_xlim(-0.6, n - 0.4)
    ax.set_ylim(0, ymax)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(shift_labels, rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=8 * FS)
    ax.set_ylabel("Downtime hours", fontsize=9 * FS)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=8 * FS)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#eeeeee", zorder=0)
    for s in ["top", "right"]:
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

    handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color=shade) for _, _, shade, _ in legend_entries]
    labels = [name for _, name, _, _ in legend_entries]
    ax.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.28),
              ncol=7, fontsize=8 * FS, frameon=False, handlelength=1.2, handleheight=1.2)

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.045, right=0.99, top=0.96, bottom=0.34)

    fig.canvas.draw()
    renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
    to_recheck = []
    for t, xi, h, full_label, short_label in pending_texts:
        bar_px_w = abs(ax.transData.transform((xi + 0.35, 0))[0] - ax.transData.transform((xi - 0.35, 0))[0])
        if t.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width > bar_px_w * 0.94:
            t.set_text(short_label)
            to_recheck.append((t, bar_px_w, short_label))
    if to_recheck:
        fig.canvas.draw()
        for t, bar_px_w, short_label in to_recheck:
            if t.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width > bar_px_w * 0.94:
                t.set_text("")

plt.show()
